description: Calculate Gibraltar Payments on Account. Splits the annual corporate tax liability into two equal payments due 28 February and 30 September. Provide either lastYearTax or lastYearProfit with optional taxRate.

lastYearProfit.description: Last year taxable profit in GBP. Provide this OR lastYearTax.

lastYearTax.description: Last year total tax liability in GBP. Provide this OR lastYearProfit.

paymentYear.description: Year for POA dates. Defaults to current year.

taxRate.description: Corporate tax rate percentage. Defaults to 15.

name: poa_calculator
